moments.text: Infrared view looking down on rippled sea inside a bright oval ring. A small light-grey spot in its own small box sits left of the crosshair.
A jagged white streak on the water slides along the bottom from the lower-right black box to the left edge, while the boxed spot nears the crosshair.
The boxed spot sits on the crosshair centre; the picture dims briefly at 16.5 s.
The picture goes dark, then grey, then flashes light; it returns zoomed in, with a bright patch around the crosshair.
Zoomed in, the spot is a light round blob with a dark left edge and a thin light tail hanging straight down, held on the crosshair to the end.

notes: Official text puts the zoom-in at 00:16-00:18; on this file it happens at 19.35 s.
